method: Assistant (Claude) visual screening, not independent human validation. All 200 images (100 M0 + 100 edited) reviewed in fixed case_id order (0-99), M0 then edited per case, labels recorded before consulting classifications.jsonl. Checkpoint identity was not blinded in the literal sense (file paths name the checkpoint), but labels were committed per-case before any cross-check against the other checkpoint's image or the classifier output, which is the practical substitute used throughout this project. Severe degeneration defined before review: substantial incoherence, corruption, or malformed content that prevents a usable image; a different subject, changed composition, ordinary text, or departure from the original image is NOT automatically degeneration.

golf_ball_summary.note: Every one of the 40 edited golf-ball images is visually free of a recognizable golf ball (full agreement with the detector's 3/40). Of those 40, 7 (17.5%) are severely degenerate (incoherent fantastical objects, warped anatomy, garbled text) rather than clean topic redirection; the remaining 33 (82.5%) are coherent alternative scenes. One M0 case (37) itself failed to render a recognizable golf ball (rendered a golf club instead) -- reported honestly as a baseline rendering miss, not forced into 'present'.

parachute_summary.ambiguous_cases: 48, 49, 50, 51 (the 'folded parachute packed in its backpack' scene) -- both checkpoints show plausible-but-not-clearly-identifiable folded fabric with no distinct canopy/harness shape; this ambiguity is a pre-existing property of this scene's prompt/rendering, not an edit-induced change (both checkpoints agree).
parachute_summary.detector_vs_visual_disagreement: case 55: visually a clear, unambiguous parachute canopy on both checkpoints; the edited-checkpoint classifier called it 'balloon' at low confidence (0.214), the only one of the 16 visually-clear edited cases the detector missed. Reconciliation: 16 visual-clear - 1 detector-disagreement = 15 detector hits, matching the reported 15/20 exactly.
parachute_summary.feasibility_note: parachute recognition is borderline on M0 (16/20, exactly at the >=16/20 bar) and below it on the GolfBall parent (15/20) -- flagged per RUN_MANIFEST.md as a real limitation on any future parachute-targeted edit's interpretability, not treated as evidence of anything yet.

french_horn_summary.edited_ambiguous_cases: 68, 73, 75, 76, 78, 79 -- mostly unusual bell proportions or extra tubing/slide elements reading as tuba/euphonium/trombone-hybrid rather than unambiguously French-horn-specific; a stricter visual standard than the classifier's instrument-family tolerance
french_horn_summary.edited_degenerate_case: 70 -- structurally confused double-bell shape with an attached purple ornament, judged substantially incoherent
french_horn_summary.note: This review's stricter 'specifically and unambiguously a French horn (not a hybrid/different brass instrument)' standard yields 14/20 clear-present for the edited checkpoint, noticeably stricter than the classifier's 18/20. This divergence is reported explicitly rather than reconciled by relaxing the visual standard after the fact; it reflects a real difference in what counts as 'the same instrument' between a coarse ImageNet class and a stricter visual read, not necessarily new damage from this edit (M0 itself has one ambiguous case on the same strict standard).

english_springer_summary.note: Uniformly excellent, near-identical preservation across all 20 cases and both checkpoints. Matches the classifier's 20/20 -> 20/20 exactly.
